lines.text: Waking up at seven, wishing time could stop
Every single day she works until she drops
Coffee’s just a thing that keeps her full of steam
When life is spilling over top
She comes in every morning, takes her coffee black
Normally I’d say there’s nothing wrong with that
But I can see the joy she’s desperate to avoid
A light that’s peeking out the cracks
Every single day the order stays the same
Safe and unadorned, she wishes it could change
Maybe she could use a push outside her lane
This cookie butter latte’s calling out her name
Freshly brewed and iced
Oh, tell me won't you try
This melody I made for you
So gently bittersweet
Where cream and coffee meet
We've always got enough for two
'Cause all the different flavors
Love to come together
Somewhere they can always play
These doors are always open
Come enjoy the hope café
Waking up at eight to bells that hurt her head
A night owl at her heart, she tries to stay in bed
But that won’t really fly, her bed won’t stop the time
No matter how sincerely pled
She passes every morning, takes a peek inside
Someone she adores reflected in her eyes
Maybe she could use some way to break the ice
An order for some waffles, perfect sharing size!
Freshly baked with pride
Oh, tell me won't you try
These melodies i made for you
They're such a tasty treat
(And our paninis can't be beat!)
They'll warm you up when you feel blue
'Cause all the different colors
Rainbow-tinted lovers
Always have a place to stay
Our doors are always open
Come enjoy the hope café
Waking up at five and wishing time could stop
It’s not always easy in this coffee shop
But when I see you smile, hear you sing along
I know it's where my heart belongs
Freshly brewed and iced
Oh, tell me won't you try
This melody I made for you
So gently bittersweet
Where cream and coffee meet
We've always got enough for two
'Cause all the different flavors
Love to come together
Somewhere they can always play
These doors are always open
Come enjoy the hope café!
YEAH I’VE GOT ALL DIFFERENT KINDS OF COFFEE
DECAF AND A CAPPUCCINO, ICE YOUR LATTE
AN AMERICANO, MACCHIATO, CHAI OR AN ICED TEA
EVEN IF YOU’RE HUNGRY TRY A WAFFLE OR PANINI

WHETHER THE WEATHER IS RAIN OR SUN OR SNOW
WE GO THE DISTANCE
